Great — fridge scanned and pantry checked! Here's my usual check-in before we dive in:

> 🔍 **Did I miss anything?** Any items in closed containers or door shelves I couldn't see? Is anything nearly finished — like the eggs, feta, or OJ? Any items in containers I couldn't identify (like that small dark sauce jar)?

---

## 🧊 Full Inventory — Fridge + Pantry

| Source | Ingredients |
|---|---|
| 🥬 Fridge — Leafy & Fresh | Butter lettuce, spinach/chard, fresh parsley |
| 🥦 Fridge — Vegetables | Broccoli, red cabbage, white/napa cabbage, kohlrabi, watermelon radish *(use soon!)*, beetroot, baby carrots |
| 🧀 Fridge — Dairy | Feta, butter, eggs (6–8) |
| 🫙 Fridge — Preserved | Tomato sauce (3 jars), olives/jam, small dark sauce |
| 🍋 Fridge — Fresh | Lemons (2–3), orange juice *(use soon!)* |
| 🥫 Pantry | Potatoes, okra, grilled chicken, prawns, Greek yoghurt, milk, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, rice, soy sauce, butter, carrots |

---

## 🍽️ Tonight's Dinner — Family-Tailored Suggestions

Keeping in mind: **your Type 2 diabetes** (low GI), **your wife's vegetarianism**, the **girls' love of chicken & eggs**, and your **Indian & Chinese cuisine preferences**! 🍛🥢

---

### 🍛 1. Indian Chicken Curry with Cauliflower Rice ⭐ Top Pick!
**Uses:** Grilled chicken *(pantry)*, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, tomato sauce, spinach, butter
A fragrant, spiced curry using your pantry staples. Wilt the spinach in at the end for extra goodness. Serve with **cauliflower rice** (blitz raw broccoli as a low-GI swap!) or a small portion of rice for the girls.
- ✅ Low GI for you (cauliflower rice swap)
- ✅ Make a vegetarian portion with eggs or feta for your wife
- ✅ Girls get their beloved chicken!
- ⏱ ~25 mins

---

### 🥢 2. Chinese-Style Prawn Stir-Fry with Vegetables
**Uses:** Prawns *(pantry)*, broccoli, carrots, red cabbage, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, onions
A quick, high-protein stir-fry with loads of crunchy veg. Serve over a small portion of rice for the family, or cauliflower rice for you.
- ✅ Low GI with cauliflower rice
- ✅ Make a separate egg & veggie stir-fry for your wife using the same sauce base
- ✅ Girls can have eggs on the side or share the prawn portion
- ⏱ ~20 mins

---

### 🫘 3. Indian Masala Okra & Potato with Eggs
**Uses:** Okra *(pantry)*, potatoes, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, tomato sauce, eggs
A classic Indian **Bhindi Masala** alongside spiced potatoes, topped with fried or poached eggs. Earthy, spiced, and deeply satisfying.
- ✅ Naturally vegetarian — great for the whole family
- ✅ Use a small portion of potato for you (moderate GI) and bulk up with extra okra (low GI!)
- ✅ Girls get their eggs!
- ⏱ ~30 mins

---

### 🌟 My Top Pick Tonight
Go for the **Indian Chicken Curry** 🍛 — it uses your grilled chicken and tomato sauce that are ready to go, the spices you already have, and spinach that needs to be eaten soon. A quick vegetarian portion with eggs or feta for your wife takes just 5 extra minutes. Everyone's happy! 😄

---

Would you like a **full recipe** for tonight's dish, or shall we use all of this to plan your **full week of family meals**? 😊
